arxiv-2111-04274.title: Critical branching as a pure death process coming down from infinity
arxiv-2111-04274.creator: Serik Sagitov
arxiv-2111-04274.description: Abstract We consider the critical Galton-Watson process with overlapping generations stemming from a single founder. Assuming that both the variance of the offspring number and the average generation length are finite, we establish the convergence of the finite-dimensional distributions, conditioned on non-extinction at a remote time of observation.

arxiv-2205-14419.title: Investigations on the flavor-dependent axial charges of the octet baryons
arxiv-2205-14419.creator: Rui Qi, Jin-Bao Wang, Gang Li, Chun-Sheng An, Cheng-Rong Deng, Ju-Jun Xie
arxiv-2205-14419.description: Abstract We have investigated the axial charges of the ground octet baryons within the extended chiral constituent quark model, where all the possible compact five-quark Fock components q ​ q ​ q ​ ( q ​ q ¯ ) ​ ( q = u , d , s ) qqq(q\bar{q})(q=u,d,s) in the baryons are considered.

arxiv-2401-06627.title: Device-independent certification of desirable properties with a confidence interval
arxiv-2401-06627.creator: Wan-Guan Chang, Kai-Chun Chen, Kai-Siang Chen, Shin-Liang Chen, Yeong-Cherng Liang
arxiv-2401-06627.description: Abstract In the development of quantum technologies, a reliable means for characterizing quantum devices, be it a measurement device, a state-preparation device, or a transformation device, is crucial. However, the conventional approach based on, for example, quantum state tomography or process tomography relies on assumptions that are often not necessarily justifiable in a realistic experimental setting.

arxiv-2403-03644.title: On the characters of a certain series of N=4 superconformal modules II
arxiv-2403-03644.creator: Minoru Wakimoto
arxiv-2403-03644.description: Abstract Abstract In this paper we compute the characters of certain non-irreducible N=4 superconformal modules which are different from the ones treated in our previous paper [ 25 ] , and study their relation with characters of N=2 superconformal modules. Also, for these non-irreducible N=4 modules, we deduce the expression of characters in terms of string functions.

arxiv-2412-19582.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Vignesh Kottayam Viswanathan, Mario Alberto Valdes Saucedo, Sumeet Gajanan Satpute. In this article, we present the Layered Semantic Graphs (LSG), a novel actionable hierarchical scene graph, fully integrated with a multi-modal mission planner, the FLIE: A First-Look based Inspection and Exploration planner [ 1 ] .

arxiv-2503-18007.title: SymmCompletion: High-Fidelity and High-Consistency Point Cloud Completion with Symmetry Guidance
arxiv-2503-18007.creator: Hongyu Yan, Zijun Li, Kunming Luo, Li Lu, Ping Tan
arxiv-2503-18007.description: Abstract Point cloud completion aims to recover a complete point shape from a partial point cloud. Although existing methods can form satisfactory point clouds in global completeness, they often lose the original geometry details and face the problem of geometric inconsistency between existing point clouds and reconstructed missing parts.

arxiv-2504-19223.title: CARL: Camera-Agnostic Representation Learning for Spectral Image Analysis
arxiv-2504-19223.creator: Alexander Baumann, Leonardo Ayala, Silvia Seidlitz, Jan Sellner, Alexander Studier-Fischer, Berkin Özdemir, Lena Maier-Hein, Slobodan Ilic
arxiv-2504-19223.description: Abstract Spectral imaging offers promising applications across diverse domains, including medicine and urban scene understanding, and is already established as a critical modality in remote sensing. However, variability in channel dimensionality and captured wavelengths among spectral cameras impede the development of AI-driven methodologies, leading to camera-specific models with limited generalizability and inadequate cross-camera applicability.

arxiv-2512-04224.title: LEBS Toolkit for Addressing Development Challenges through Astronomy
arxiv-2512-04224.creator: Joyful E. Mdhluli on behalf of the IAU Office of Astronomy for Development
arxiv-2512-04224.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Joyful E. Mdhluli on behalf of the IAU Office of Astronomy for Development. The LEBS Toolkit provides a comprehensive framework for astronomers and natural scientists to address development challenges through their field. The toolkit aligns with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and offers practical actions to achieve development outcomes. It emphasises the importance of effective communication between astronomy and development, highlighting four key components: Leadership, Externalities, Break Barriers to Entry and Support Functioning Markets & Institutions (LEBS).

pmc-10575252.title: Unsupervised Mixture Models on the Edge for Smart Energy Consumption Segmentation with Feature Saliency
pmc-10575252.creator: Hussein Al-Bazzaz, Muhammad Azam, Manar Amayri, Nizar Bouguila
pmc-10575252.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Smart meter datasets have recently transitioned from monthly intervals to one-second granularity, yielding invaluable insights for diverse metering functions. Clustering analysis, a fundamental data mining technique, is extensively applied to discern unique energy consumption patterns. However, the advent of high-resolution smart meter data brings forth formidable challenges, including non-Gaussian data distributions, unknown cluster counts, and varying feature importance within high-dimensional spaces. This article introduces an innovative learning framework integrating the expectation-maximization algorithm with the minimum message length criterion.

pmc-10738514.title: THE EFFECT OF PANDEMICS ON TRUST IN DOCTOR IMPROVEMENT AMONG CHINESE OLDER ADULTS: LESSONS FROM COVID-19
pmc-10738514.creator: Chao Guo, Xiyuan Hu, Dianqi Yuan, Huameng Tang, Peisen Yang
pmc-10738514.description: The COVID-19 pandemic has had a major impact on the physician-patient relationship. For older adults, trust in doctors during the pandemic affects their lives and health. This study aimed to estimate the effect of the first wave of COVID-19 transmissibility in China on older adults’ trust in doctors. We obtained individual data from the Chinese Family Panel Studies (CFPS).

pmc-11300642.title: A qualitative analysis of Chinese higher education students’ intentions and influencing factors in using ChatGPT: a grounded theory approach
pmc-11300642.creator: Zhaoyang Liu, Wenlan Zhang
pmc-11300642.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The emergence of ChatGPT has significantly impacted the field of education. While much of the existing research has predominantly examined the theoretical implications of ChatGPT, there is a notable absence of empirical studies substantiating these claims. As pivotal stakeholders in education and primary users of ChatGPT, exploring the willingness and influencing factors of higher education students to use ChatGPT can offer valuable insights into the real-world needs of student users.

pmc-11478200.title: Comparative Analysis of Mechanical Properties: Conventional vs. Additive Manufacturing for Stainless Steel 316L
pmc-11478200.creator: Constantin Alex Sumanariu, Cătălin Gheorghe Amza, Florin Baciu, Mihai Ion Vasile, Adrian Ionut Nicoara, Oldrich Sucharda
pmc-11478200.description: This research investigates the tensile strength and microstructural properties of stainless steel 316L, comparing samples fabricated using additive manufacturing (AM) to those produced via conventional manufacturing techniques such as forging and casting using stainless steel 316L for its mechanical performance and corrosion resistance.

pmc-12462338.title: Population-based estimates of healthy working life expectancy in China
pmc-12462338.creator: Guogui Huang, Yao Pan, Yanan Luo
pmc-12462338.description: BackgroundDespite growing interest in population aging and extended working lives, little is known in developing countries about people’s quality of working life and their capacity to work for longer years when approaching retirement age. This study therefore aimed to estimate the healthy working life expectancy for the middle-aged and older population in China.

pmc-12684710.title: Technical assessment of two swab types for human and microbial DNA extraction from latent fingerprints
pmc-12684710.creator: Josep De Alcaraz-Fossoul, Francisco Medina-Paz, Sara C Zapico
pmc-12684710.description: Latent fingerprints are a valuable yet challenging source of both human and microbial DNA, especially when ridge patterns are of poor visual quality with little to no identification potential. The efficiency of DNA collection and extraction depends on the choice of the sampling technique and the specimen conditions.

pmc-12690737.title: SBPS-07 Management of craniopharyngiomas with cystic component in the Neurosurgery Department of the Mother Child University Hospital of Bamako.
pmc-12690737.creator: Mamadou Salia Diarra, Cisse Mohamed Elhassimi, Keita Abdoulaye, Kanikomo Drissa, Oumar Diallo
pmc-12690737.description: IntroductionHistologically “benign tumors”, craniopharyngiomas have “malignant locations” and are recurrent, invading the anatomical structures of the base of the skull. Their location, evolution and size make their management difficult and controversial. Various techniques are used such as excision, reservoir placement and/or injection of intracystic chemotherapy.

pmc-12736558.title: Recursive Batch Smoother with Multiple Linearization for One Class of Nonlinear Estimation Problems: Application for Multisensor Navigation Data Fusion
pmc-12736558.creator: Oleg Stepanov, Alexey Isaev, Elena Dranitsyna, Yulia Litvinenko
pmc-12736558.description: A class of nonlinear filtering problems connected with data fusion from various navigation sensors and a navigation system is considered. A special feature of these problems is that the posterior probability density function (PDF) of the state vector being estimated changes its character from multi-extremal to single-extremal as measurements accumulate.

pmc-13302310.title: Comparing left-ventricular-only and biventricular pacing for smarter synchronization
pmc-13302310.creator: A Spadotto, G Martini, A Carecci, A Angeletti, G Massaro, L Bartoli, C Martignani, I Diemberger, M Ziacchi, G Statuto, M Biffi

pmc-13381207.title: A utility of air–liquid interface cultured airway epithelium for the development of antiviral agents: translation beyond biology
pmc-13381207.creator: Kazuhiro Ito
pmc-13381207.description: The development of antiviral therapies for respiratory viruses continues to be a major unmet clinical need. One of the key challenges in antiviral drug discovery is the identification of preclinical systems that faithfully reproduce essential features of the human airway while retaining clinical relevance.

pmc-13586631.title: Thermotolerance thresholds of the photosystem II increase with elevation in conifer species in the Spanish Pyrenees
pmc-13586631.creator: N. Kunert, E. Düsterhöft
pmc-13586631.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In vitro‐measured photosystem II (PSII) thermotolerance, indicated by the temperature‐dependent decline of the quantum use efficiency of PSII, has been broadly applied to evaluate plants' ability to deal with future climate warming.
